authoritative_contract.status: proposed portable evidence envelope; not production importer or admission

scope: Existing schema field mapping and bounded local synthetic shape checks only. No schema edits, new framework, adapter, collection or publication.

mapping_ids.facet: source artifact, language, revision and exact locator
mapping_ids.limits: Whole-byte content_sha256 only for inspected bytes. Git commit/blob IDs and excerpt hashes require separately typed sidecar fields. A current read establishes current availability, not historical source bytes.

mapping_ids.facet: publisher release label versus request alias
mapping_ids.limits: Use version_certainty=provider_label for a documented release label. Mutable API request alias is sidecar request_id, not immutable provider_model_id, artifact_digest, or substitute for version_label. Host/platform/region/mode and served_as/redirected_to relations are not typed native fields.

release_event has no schedule/observed discriminator. Do not map a scheduled date to withdrawal or times.event as an event that happened. A separately evidenced announcement/document update can use release_kind=announcement/update at its real documentation event date, with planned date and unresolved status in sidecar.

One exact category per observation, preserve 0.14/0.55/2.19 strings. Per-million denominator and input/output/cache/mode/time category must remain explicit in definition/scope. These categories have no dedicated typed schema fields. Use actor subject if model identity unresolved; a stronger model join requires a supported model_version record.

temporal.date preserves day precision. temporal.range endpoints are inclusive by contract, so do not use it for an interval whose inclusivity is unknown. Unknown boundaries stay separate null fields/reasons in sidecar; no inferred UTC instant or February8 boundary.

Do not fill publisher translation method/translator if unknown. Two official language pages can instead remain source artifacts with a sidecar same-event relation. A current English body does not establish historical wording or a Chinese original.

supersedes means immediately preceding revision of same record ID, not a provider replacement, distinct language page, independent model release or event conflict. Revision >=2 requires supersedes. Contradicts is an evidence relation; generic event graph remains sidecar.

Hold a run join when execution platform/time/returned version is absent. A release or tariff announcement is no substitute. No native API invocation/deployment record; no test execution or billed usage is established.

inference_price is allowed; inference_cost is not a resource_kind enum. A tariff-derived estimate could only be a separately identified estimated observation with assumptions, never this reported tariff. Invoice, subsidy, provider economic cost and energy are null/not measured in this review. No billing conclusion.

Single rights state cannot replace artifact-specific four-way rights assessment. Unknown rights remain unknown. Research verification is not human_verified operator review, and eligible is not admitted or published.

vocabulary.azure_source_vocabulary_rule: Documentation Deprecated maps to API Deprecating; API Deprecated denotes retired. Keep source and normalized vocabulary separate.

statistical_context.required_billing_unit: USD per 1,000,000 tokens with direction/cache/mode/time category
statistical_context.sample_size: omit; do not insert null because schema requires integer when present
statistical_context.uncertainty_notes: Record documentary identity/date/rights uncertainty, not manufactured sampling uncertainty.

null_handling: Native schemas generally reject arbitrary nulls and additional fields. Omit unsupported optional native fields or use temporal.kind=unknown with reason/value.kind=missing where those unions apply. Preserve explicit null plus reason and unsupported facets in review sidecar, not arbitrary additions to a conforming record.
historical_decimal_rule: Catalog numbers are preserved verbatim in data/evidence-program/research/followups/model-tariff-review-prior-catalog-preservation.json. Proposed native representations use exact strings; they do not rewrite the historical catalog.
validation_limit: Offline JSON Schema detects shape only. Semantic joins, source truth, lineage completeness, rights and no-leakage rules need the manual acceptance decision. No repository validator or source code is executed.

completed_checks.test_tool: installed jsonschema Draft202012Validator with FormatChecker, offline
completed_checks.semantic_review: Each smoke case includes manual semantic disposition; source and historical joins require separate evidence.
